records.subject: Increasing electrolyte concentration m
records.quote: We evaluated the performances of liquid thermoelectric conversion devices (LTEs) composed of nine organic solvents containing an Fe2+/Fe3+ redox pair against the electrolyte concentration (m).
context_quotes: In protic solvents, i.e. methanol (Me), ethanol (Et), 1-propanol (Pr), and ethylene glycol (EG), the electrochemical Seebeck coefficient (alpha = d V/d T, where V and T are the electrode potential and temperature, respectively) increases with m in the small m region.
